definitions.explanation: A vehicle coming toward one from the opposite direction on the same road. Common in driving instruction, traffic news and accident reports.

examples.japanese: {対向車|たいこうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To watch out for oncoming cars.

examples.japanese: {対向車|たいこうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ライト→ライト：13631_raito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まぶしかった→まぶしい：03737_mabushii⟧。
examples.english: The headlights of the oncoming cars were dazzling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{右折|うせつ}→右折：09217_usetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{対向車|たいこうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{途切|とぎ}れる→途切れる：18055_togireru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{待|ま}た→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: When turning right, you have to wait until there is a gap in the oncoming traffic.

notes:
Japan drives on the left, so oncoming traffic matters most when turning right (⟦{右折|うせつ}→右折：09217_usetsu⟧), the turn that crosses it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対向車線|たいこうしゃせん}: the opposite lane
- {対向車|たいこうしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦すれ{違|ちが}う→すれ違う：02122_surechigau⟧: to pass an oncoming car
- {対向車|たいこうしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{衝突|しょうとつ}する→衝突する：26785_shoutotsusuru⟧: to collide with an oncoming car

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {後続車|こうぞくしゃ}: the car behind; following traffic
